messages:
Alex: heads up — noticed p99 on the latency dashboard for service=api-realtime jumped ~40% right after the routing policy tweak yesterday. p50/p95 look fine. endpoint breakdown shows p99 only for /v1/stream responses. anyone else?
Maria: which dashboard view? the new 'Endpoints > Percentiles' or the old one? can you paste the slice/filter you used? :eyes:
Alex: the Console -> Latency -> Endpoints with p50/p95/p99 split, filtered to region=us-east and model=redwood-13b. here's the slice link: https://console/redwood/latency?endpoint=/v1/stream
Dan: hmm, suspecting fallback path. yesterday's routing change lowered primary pool weight -> some requests now hitting reserved-legacy pool which has higher tail. p50/p95 stable because most requests still on fast pool, p99 dominated by the tiny tail on the legacy pool.
Olivia: we saw quota pressure around 03:12 UTC that flipped some requests to fallback pool. infra logs show repeated "quota_exceeded" for tenant=acme-co at 03:11-03:16.
Olivia: log snippet:
```
{"time":"2026-02-18T03:12:08Z","tenant":"acme-co","route":"api-realtime","decision":"fallback","reason":"quota_exceeded","target":"pool:reserved-legacy"}
```
Jeff: quick check — is the console percentile computed after merging sample origins (tdigest rollup) or by merging per-origin percentiles? that makes a big difference for tails. if we merge tdigests across origins it's mathematically sound, but UI rollups sometimes hide origin counts so it looks wrong.
Maria: Console backend currently merges tdigest rollups from each shard then extracts pctl. However the dashboard tooltip collapses origin info by default, so you can't see that the p99 is from origin X.
Alex: that explains it. So the raw math is ok, but UX is misleading. Users see p99 jump and assume service regression.
Dan: also note sampling: some routes send only 1/20 samples to telemetry. if the slow pool had a higher sample fraction for a minute it can exaggerate p99. we should show sample_count alongside percentiles.
Jeff: two action ideas: 1) immediate — show origin badges and sample_count in the percentile hover for endpoints; 2) medium — add a small note explaining that pctl is aggregated from merged tdigests and recommend drilling by origin for tail debugging.
Olivia: I can open a quick PR to add sample_count and origin tag into the tooltip. should be a tiny UX patch.
infra-bot: route-policy-service v2.4 deployed by @deploy-bot at 2026-02-18T02:58:43Z (sha: b7a9c3e) :rocket:
Maria: thanks Olivia — also can we add a one-click drilldown that re-runs percentile query partitioned by sample_origin? reduces back-and-forth.
Olivia: yep I'll add the drilldown link in the PR, ETA today EOD.
Alex: thanks all. next steps: Olivia PR for tooltip + drilldown, Dan to verify sampling fractions for the interval, Jeff to draft short Console FAQ blurb explaining merge semantics. I'll update oncall if customers flag this. :thumbsup:
Jeff: +1. ping me if you want me to word the FAQ.
Maria: filing a tiny dashboard incident note so CS has context.
Alex: moving to close once PR merges and we verify tail reduces after routing weight tweak. :wave:
